title: Turo Abien no Mufo
intro: Wɔ asase bi a nhyira pii sen so so no, bere bi na ɔmanfo bi ani gye turo abien a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛdɔɔso no ho. Na wɔn abrabɔ yɛ ɔsoro adom ho adanse, nanso wɔn asɛm no danee bere a aseda so tewee, na ɛde nsakrae a ɛbɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtra hɔ daa ama wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho nyinaa bae.
clues: Na yɛyɛ nkurɔfo a wɔahyira yɛn asase a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛdɔɔso.
Yɛn Awurade maa yɛn turo akɛseɛ mmienu a ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm na ɛsow aba wɔ afã biara.
Wɔhyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnda ase, nanso yɛpaw anisɔ a yenni na yɛdan yɛn ho.
Atare kɛse bi siw nsu a ɛmaa yɛn asase no nkwa no ano.
Bere a yɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ yɛn bɔne no, abura no paee na nsuyiri no faa mu.
Wɔde nnuaba a ɛyɛ nwononwono, tamarisk, ne lote nnua kakraa bi besii yɛn turo a bere bi na ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm no ananmu.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Mframa a ano yɛ den bɔɔ anadwo ason
Nsuyiri a ɛsɛe ade a efi abura bi a ɛrepae mu
Nteɛteɛm kɛse bi a efi wim
Nsu a ɛremene wɔ po mu
trial.answer: Nsuyiri a ɛsɛe ade a efi abura bi a ɛrepae mu

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔde nnuaba a ɛyɛ nwononwono ne nnua a ɛso yɛ hare sii yɛn turo no ananmu
Wɔdanee yɛn yɛɛ akraman ne mprako
outcome.answer: Wɔde nnuaba a ɛyɛ nwononwono ne nnua a ɛso yɛ hare sii yɛn turo no ananmu

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
